english.note: For sleep, use 熟 in the expression 瞓得好熟 to mean sleeping soundly and being hard to wake.

exampleSentences.english: They were sleeping deep and could not be woken up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢瞓得好熟，叫極都唔醒。
